main.description: Invite customers: mint one single-use customers-space invite per address, each expiring after expiresInDays, and record which address each went to, so a redeemed invite pairs the address with the account. Redeemed with actor.acceptInvite. Staff only.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID, new for each attempt; a retry reuses it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or may not invite to the customers space: only its creator or a HappyView super user may.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: emails is not 1 to 50 distinct addresses, expiresInDays is not a whole number from 1 to 30, or idempotencyKey is not a UUID.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: A request with this idempotencyKey is still running.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The customers space is not configured, an invite could not be made, or the addresses could not be recorded. Nothing is returned then: an invite whose address is not recorded is never handed out, and simply expires.

token.description: The secret the invitee redeems. Shown once: HappyView and the provisioner keep only its hash.
